extracted.name: Salmon Spread II
extracted.description: Poached salmon elevates a simple cream cheese spread to new heights! Serve with crackers.
instruction_lines: In a medium saucepan of simmering water, poach the salmon filets 10 minutes, or until flaky and tender.
In a medium bowl, mix together cream cheese, sour cream, green onions, salt, hot pepper sauce, lemon juice and Worcestershire sauce.
Flake salmon into the mixture. Cover and refrigerate 8 hours, or overnight, before serving.
